answers.core: This can't be implemented in an add-on as `main.cpp` must be modified. This means custom MovieWriters can't implement this efficiently on their own, as `get_data()` would still be called on the Viewport every frame, leading to performance degradation (especially at high resolutions).
answers.workaround: This can be worked around by [rendering all frames then discarding some of them with FFmpeg](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/animation/creating_movies.html#generating-accumulation-motion-blur-with-ffmpeg), but this is much slower than not saving those frames in the first place.

title: Add subframe rendering to Movie Maker mode to improve rendering quality
